prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical 4:5 watercolor-and-ink travel portrait illustration of a young woman standing on a sunlit Mediterranean coastal street. She is shown from mid-thigh up, centered slightly left, facing the viewer with a calm soft smile, large round eyeglasses, expressive dark eyes, natural brows, and shoulder-length tousled dark brown hair. She wears an oversized pale blue denim jacket with off-white loose sleeves over a white shirt, tucked into light blue jeans with a black belt. She holds a loose bouquet in the foreground containing exactly 5 prominent flowers: 2 yellow sunflowers, 1 deep blue daisy-like flower, 1 lavender daisy-like flower, and 1 small pale purple flower, with many green leaves and delicate filler stems. The background is an airy seaside European village scene inspired by the Amalfi Coast: terraced white buildings descending toward a blue ocean on the left, distant blue mountains, a bright watercolor sky with soft cloud blooms, and a narrow stone street on the right lined with aged cream buildings, wrought-iron balconies, potted plants, tangled overhead utility wires, a round wall clock, blue and red shop awnings, café chairs, and a vintage bicycle with a wicker basket full of flowers. Include exactly 3 seagulls in the sky and exactly 2 small butterflies near the left side of the portrait. Use delicate black ink linework, loose architectural sketching, transparent watercolor washes, splatters, paper texture, warm sunlight, pastel blues and creams, fine facial detail, and a romantic travel-journal aesthetic. Keep the composition elegant and vertical, with the portrait crispest and the scenery slightly looser; no text, no watermark, no photorealism.
